title: Deliverance from Sin's Dominion
definition: Deliverance from Sin's Dominion is God's freeing of believers from sin's ruling power through union with Christ.
summary: In Christ, sin no longer reigns as master over the believer.
christFocus: Jesus Christ died and rose so His people would no longer be enslaved to sin.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Deliverance from Sin's Dominion helps explain how God saves sinners through Jesus Christ rather than through human merit, religious performance, or self-rescue. This doctrine shows that salvation is personal, covenantal, and centered on the finished work of Christ.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can understand the grace they have received and proclaim the Gospel with clarity. It guards the Church from confusion by keeping sin, grace, faith, repentance, righteousness, forgiveness, and eternal hope in their biblical order.

The heart of this doctrine is in christ, sin no longer reigns as master over the believer.. It should lead to worship, assurance, humility, holiness, and a deeper confidence in the Savior who saves completely.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because people easily drift toward either despair or self-righteousness. Deliverance from Sin's Dominion reminds believers that salvation belongs to the Lord, rests in Christ, and produces real transformation without turning grace into license or obedience into a way to earn acceptance with God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility and examine whether your hope is resting in Christ. Let deliverance from sin's dominion shape your prayers, your witness, your repentance, and your daily confidence that Jesus is able to save and keep all who come to God through Him.
